summary: Perfect Corp. filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, including balance sheet, equity rollforward, receivables aging, credit-risk and segment disclosures (Taiwan, USA, Japan, Shanghai, BVI, France, Wannaby entities). No transaction, corporate action, or shareholder matter is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary periodic report by a foreign private issuer, the US equivalent of a domestic quarterly report on Form 10-Q. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics to assess, and no risk-arbitrage angle arises.
